title: Transfer to BHI
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Attach correct pipette
steps.instruction: Verify that the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette is mounted on the robot (left or right mount as desired) before starting.

steps.title: Load labware onto deck
steps.instruction: Place the following labware in the indicated slots: Slot 1 – Fisherbrand 2‑20 µL tips; Slot 2 – Simport Scientific 500 µL tubes in custom holder (source); Slot 3 – Simport Scientific 500 µL tubes in custom holder (destination).

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, set the pipette mount (left or right) and specify the number of samples to transfer (any integer from 1 to 96).

steps.title: Generate and download protocol
steps.instruction: Enter the protocol parameters in the customization fields and click to download the generated protocol file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Set up deck per deck map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the deck map, confirming the labware positions defined in step 2.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the tiprack, source tubes, destination tubes, and the P300‑Multi pipette (refer to support articles for calibration tips if needed).

steps.title: Execute transfer run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 Run App to start the buffered peptone water transfer to BHI.
